text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE) with associated neonatal seizures and metabolic acidosis.

I have noted the history of chorioamnionitis, low Apgar scores, and the onset of seizures and lethargy at 31 weeks gestation.
